text: But as nothing is more caly than to write originally wrong; originals are not here recommended, but under the theory graed of the fruit rule--_Know _byful/_ La- cian, who was an original, neglected not this rule, if we may judge by the reply to one who took fone freedom with him. He was as first a happened to a fortury; and when he was reflected on as fach, by being called _Premichaela_, he applied, "I am indeed the inventor of a new work. He model of which I owe to mine, and, if I do not execute it well, I deferve to be tom by twelve vulures, instead of one."
